summary: A mixed day driven by regulatory tightening on retail and e-commerce, major Reliance capital raise, and global AI sector volatility. Legal developments focus on reproductive rights and family law.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via 5-year rupee bond sale, first issuance since 2023.
Amazon adding 150 new delivery stations across 118 cities including 12 new markets for last-mile operations ahead of festive season.
Kerala High Court grants woman relief to use frozen embryos after husband's death, overturning IVF hospital denial.
Global tech stocks including Nvidia and SK Hynix fall up to 10% as Anthropic CEO calls for AI development slowdown amid safety concerns.
Bombay High Court receives PIL challenging Maharashtra rule restricting abortions beyond 24 weeks of pregnancy.
